xmlPartRange.rule: Owned byte range may change length only with complete before/after ownership evidence. Prefix and suffix bytes are exact. Capsule bytes, namespace bindings, owner slot, and previous/next sibling bytes are exact. Byte-identical input may omit evidence.

semanticZip.rule: Entry set, map key, and meta.path are exact. Unknown metadata keys fail. Every payload must be a Uint8Array and is exact unless an owned changed path passes the XML range comparator. Only allowedMetadataFields may differ; every other exact-schema field is exact.

canonicalState.jsonSafety: Unknown/result data recursively accepts only null, booleans, finite numbers, strings, dense arrays without extra keys, and Object.prototype objects with safe enumerable data keys. Reject undefined, non-finite numbers, functions, symbols, cycles, sparse arrays, accessors, unsafe keys, and unsupported prototypes.
canonicalState.keyOrder: direct manual serialization in ascending ECMAScript UTF-16 code-unit lexical comparison using a < b for every key including integer-like keys; never rebuild an object and never use locale collation
canonicalState.capsuleOwnerIdentity: capsules.ownerBlockId is the canonical block ID and must equal manifest.unsupportedCapsule.ownerSlot.blockId; it is never a paragraph semantic ID
canonicalState.identityAndBytes: Block, paragraph, mark, capsule, and anchor IDs are nonempty and globally unique. Mark kinds/ranges are valid and nonzero. Capsule and sibling bytes are nonempty even-length hexadecimal.

authoredPropertyVariants.raw: Exact keys {state,rawLexical}; state is raw and rawLexical matches ^-?[0-9]{1,32}$.
authoredPropertyVariants.value: Exact keys {state,value}; state is value and value is a boolean, a nonempty string, or a finite safe integer.
authoredPropertyVariants.closedUnion: Unknown states and all extra or missing fields fail.

fields: Y.Map text records with Y.Text child
collision candidates and deterministic repaired IDs
yjsSchemaFingerprint.rule: Every record exactly matches the frozen fields and carries exact container tags for root, root maps, records, order arrays, mark/capsule arrays, Y.Text content, allocator actor map, and observed-ID maps. Creation IDs obey actorId:commitSeq:localSeq; CommitIds obey commit-{commitSeq} and agree with CreationId. Relative endpoints bind nonempty document/backend/schema/checkpoint/text fields, exact affinities, and canonical base64url bytes. Every story, block, text, mark, and capsule occurs exactly once in its owning order/membership and agrees with all references. Each actor allocator counter is strictly beyond all observed creation and commit sequences and its observed semantic set covers all current/proposed IDs. Collision precedence is ActorId, CommitId, numeric localSeq, then CreationId in UTF-16 code-unit order. Invalid identical replicas fail validation.

paginationFingerprint.rule: Canonicalize actual page structures as UTF-8 canonical JSON, then compare exact bytes and SHA-256.

counterCeilings.rule: All counters are required nonnegative integers and must not exceed nonnegative integer ceilings.
